scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.heroku-postbuild: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false npm install --prefix server && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "require('fs').accessSync('client/dist/index.html'); console.log('heroku-postbuild: client/dist OK')"
